mapper.select: SELECT user_id, password, enabled FROM user_account WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT role_code FROM user_role_assignment WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY role_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_account (user_account_uuid, user_id, password, enabled) VALUES (UUID(), #{userId}, #{password}, #{enabled})
INSERT INTO user_role_assignment (user_role_assignment_id, user_id, role_code) VALUES (UUID(), #{userId}, #{roleCode})
